+    assert provenance_violations(_fixture_catalog(entry), today=dt.date(2026, 10, 14)) == []
+
+
+def test_docs_path_must_exist_and_stay_under_docs(tmp_path):
+    (tmp_path / "docs").mkdir()
+    (tmp_path / "docs" / "prices.md").write_text("x\n")
+    ok = {"open_weight": True, "price_source": "docs/prices.md", "price_date": "2026-10-01", **PRICED}
+    assert provenance_violations(_fixture_catalog(ok), repo_root=tmp_path, today=dt.date(2026, 10, 14)) == []
+    missing = dict(ok, price_source="docs/none.md")
+    assert any("does not exist" in x for x in provenance_violations(_fixture_catalog(missing), repo_root=tmp_path))
+    escape = dict(ok, price_source="docs/../secrets.md")
+    assert any("https:// URL or a path under docs/" in x
+               for x in provenance_violations(_fixture_catalog(escape), repo_root=tmp_path))
+    http = dict(ok, price_source="http://example.com/p")
+    assert any("https:// URL or a path under docs/" in x for x in provenance_violations(_fixture_catalog(http)))

+
+def test_bad_or_future_price_date_fails():

+    assert any("no price_date" in x for x in provenance_violations(_fixture_catalog(dict(base, price_date="14/10/2026"))))
+    assert any("not a real date" in x for x in provenance_violations(_fixture_catalog(dict(base, price_date="2026-02-30"))))
+    assert any("in the future" in x for x in provenance_violations(
+        _fixture_catalog(dict(base, price_date="2026-11-01")), today=dt.date(2026, 10, 14)))
+
+
+def test_zero_priced_open_weight_entry_needs_no_provenance():
+    entry = {"open_weight": True, "pricing": {"input_per_mtok": 0, "output_per_mtok": 0}}
+    assert provenance_violations(_fixture_catalog(entry)) == []
+
+
+def test_non_open_weight_entry_is_not_checked():
+    assert provenance_violations(_fixture_catalog(dict(PRICED))) == []
+
+
+# --- the pricing module: provenance read, freshness WARN, ledger source -----------------------------------------------
+
+def test_find_pricing_reads_the_provenance_fields():
+    cfg = _fixture_catalog({"open_weight": True, "price_source": "https://example.com/p", "price_date": "2026-10-01",
+                            **PRICED})
+    entry = find_pricing("local", "qwen-x", cfg)

+    assert entry.open_weight is True
+    assert entry.price_source == "https://example.com/p"
+    assert entry.price_date == "2026-10-01"

+
+def test_yaml_date_is_read_as_iso_string():
+    cfg = yaml.safe_load("providers:\n  local:\n    models:\n      qwen-x:\n        price_date: 2026-10-01\n"
+                         "        pricing: {input_per_mtok: 1, output_per_mtok: 1}\n")
+    assert find_pricing("local", "qwen-x", cfg).price_date == "2026-10-01"

+
+def test_stale_price_is_marked_and_warned(caplog):
+    today = dt.date(2026, 10, 14)
+    fresh = find_pricing("local", "qwen-x", _fixture_catalog(dict(PRICED, price_date=(
+        today - dt.timedelta(days=STALE_PRICE_DAYS)).isoformat())))
+    stale = find_pricing("local", "qwen-x", _fixture_catalog(dict(PRICED, price_date=(
+        today - dt.timedelta(days=STALE_PRICE_DAYS + 1)).isoformat())))
+    assert not price_is_stale(fresh, today)
+    assert pricing_source_for(fresh, today) == "config"
+    pricing_mod._STALE_WARNED.clear()
+    with caplog.at_level(logging.WARNING, logger="loa_cheval.metering.pricing"):
+        assert pricing_source_for(stale, today) == "stale_catalog"
+        assert pricing_source_for(stale, today) == "stale_catalog"
+    warns = [r for r in caplog.records if "stale_catalog" in r.getMessage()]
+    assert len(warns) == 1   # once per entry per process
+    assert pricing_source_for(None) == "unknown"

+
+def test_entry_without_price_date_is_never_stale():

+    assert row["pricing_resolution"] == "exact"

+
+def test_ledger_row_without_provenance_is_config():

+                              output_tokens=10, reasoning_tokens=0, latency_ms=1, config=_fixture_catalog(dict(PRICED)))

+
+# --- the price lookup CLI ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def _cli(tmp_path: Path, *args: str, catalog: Dict[str, Any] | None = None, project: str | None = None):
+    cat = tmp_path / "model-config.yaml"
+    cat.write_text(yaml.safe_dump(catalog if catalog is not None else {
+        "providers": {
+            "openai": {"models": {"gpt-x": {"pricing": {"input_per_mtok": 5000000, "output_per_mtok": 30000000}}}},
+            "local": {"models": {"free-x": {"pricing": {"input_per_mtok": 0, "output_per_mtok": 0}}}},
+        },
+        "aliases": {"gx": "openai:gpt-x", "free": "local:free-x"},
+    }))
+    conf = tmp_path / "loa.config.yaml"
+    conf.write_text(project or "{}\n")
+    env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONPATH=str(ADAPTERS), PYTHONSAFEPATH="1")
+    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-W", "ignore::RuntimeWarning", "-m", "loa_cheval.metering.pricing",
+                           "--catalog", str(cat), "--config", str(conf), *args],
+                          capture_output=True, text=True, env=env, cwd=str(tmp_path), timeout=60)
+
+
+def test_cli_prints_catalog_rates(tmp_path):
+    r = _cli(tmp_path, "--alias", "gx")
+    assert r.returncode == 0, r.stderr
+    assert r.stdout.strip() == "alias=gx input_per_mtok=5000000 output_per_mtok=30000000 pricing_source=config"
+
+
+def test_cli_json_unknown_and_zero(tmp_path):

+    assert rows[1]["pricing_source"] == "config" and rows[1]["input_per_mtok"] == 0 and rows[1]["output_per_mtok"] == 0
+    assert rows[2]["input_per_mtok"] == 5000000 and rows[2]["provider"] == "openai"

+def test_cli_project_config_overlays_the_catalog(tmp_path):

+def test_cli_unreadable_catalog_is_a_usage_error(tmp_path):
+    env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONPATH=str(ADAPTERS), PYTHONSAFEPATH="1")
+    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-W", "ignore::RuntimeWarning", "-m", "loa_cheval.metering.pricing",
+                        "--catalog", str(tmp_path / "missing.yaml"), "--alias", "x"],
+                       capture_output=True, text=True, env=env, cwd=str(tmp_path), timeout=60)

+"""cycle-129 FR-7 (SDD D-7.1, D-7.2; sprint-257 Task 3.1, AC-3.1).

content.content:
1	+Every example block in `.loa.config.yaml.example` marked `# @example-begin <name>` …
2	+`# @example-end` is uncommented, merged over the System defaults with the real cheval
3	+loader, and must load. The insecure-endpoint refusals (a public http host, a boolean
4	+opt-in, an opt-in naming a public host, a DNS name, a link-local or metadata address,
5	+a unique-local IPv6 address, a mismatched host) each fail at load with a named reason;
6	+`::1`, `[::1]` and RFC1918 opt-ins are accepted when they match; one provider's opt-in
7	+leaves another provider's refusals intact.
8	+"""
9	+
10	+from __future__ import annotations
11	+
12	+import copy
13	+import re
14	+import shutil
15	+import sys
16	+from pathlib import Path
17	+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Tuple
18	+
19	+import pytest
20	+import yaml
21	+
22	+sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
23	+
24	+from loa_cheval.config.endpoint_policy import EndpointPolicyError  # noqa: E402
25	+from loa_cheval.config.loader import clear_config_cache, load_config  # noqa: E402
26	+from loa_cheval.types import ConfigError  # noqa: E402
27	+
28	+REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
29	+EXAMPLE = REPO_ROOT / ".loa.config.yaml.example"
30	+DEFAULTS = REPO_ROOT / ".claude" / "defaults" / "model-config.yaml"
31	+
32	+_BEGIN = re.compile(r"^#\s*@example-begin\s+([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)\s*$")
33	+_END = re.compile(r"^#\s*@example-end\s*$")
34	+
35	+
36	+def extract_examples(text: str) -> List[Tuple[str, str]]:
37	+    """(name, uncommented YAML) for every marked block. One leading `#` and one
38	+    following space are removed per line; a nested or unterminated block fails."""
39	+    blocks: List[Tuple[str, str]] = []
40	+    name = None
41	+    lines: List[str] = []
42	+    for raw in text.splitlines():
43	+        if name is None:
44	+            m = _BEGIN.match(raw)
45	+            if m:
46	+                name, lines = m.group(1), []
47	+            elif _END.match(raw):
48	+                raise AssertionError("@example-end without @example-begin")
49	+            continue
50	+        if _BEGIN.match(raw):
51	+            raise AssertionError(f"nested @example-begin inside {name}")
52	+        if _END.match(raw):
53	+            blocks.append((name, "\n".join(lines) + "\n"))
54	+            name = None
55	+            continue
56	+        assert raw.startswith("#"), f"example {name}: every line must be commented: {raw!r}"
57	+        body = raw[1:]
58	+        lines.append(body[1:] if body.startswith(" ") else body)
59	+    assert name is None, f"unterminated example block {name}"
60	+    return blocks
61	+
62	+
63	+def _project(tmp_path: Path, hounfour: Dict[str, Any]) -> str:
64	+    root = tmp_path / "proj"
65	+    (root / ".claude" / "defaults").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
66	+    shutil.copy(DEFAULTS, root / ".claude" / "defaults" / "model-config.yaml")
67	+    (root / ".loa.config.yaml").write_text(yaml.safe_dump({"hounfour": hounfour}, sort_keys=False))
68	+    return str(root)
69	+
70	+

72	+    clear_config_cache()
73	+    merged, _ = load_config(project_root=_project(tmp_path, hounfour))
74	+    return merged
75	+
76	+
77	+EXAMPLES = extract_examples(EXAMPLE.read_text())
78	+_BY_NAME = {n: yaml.safe_load(y)["hounfour"] for n, y in EXAMPLES}

92	+    merged = _load(tmp_path, doc["hounfour"])

108	+    assert prov["keyless"] is True
109	+    assert prov["allow_insecure_endpoint"] == "127.0.0.1"

file.content:
+Every example block in `.loa.config.yaml.example` marked `# @example-begin <name>` …
+`# @example-end` is uncommented, merged over the System defaults with the real cheval
+loader, and must load. The insecure-endpoint refusals (a public http host, a boolean
+opt-in, an opt-in naming a public host, a DNS name, a link-local or metadata address,
+a unique-local IPv6 address, a mismatched host) each fail at load with a named reason;
+`::1`, `[::1]` and RFC1918 opt-ins are accepted when they match; one provider's opt-in
+leaves another provider's refusals intact.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import copy
+import re
+import shutil
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Tuple
+
+import pytest
+import yaml
+
+sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
+
+from loa_cheval.config.endpoint_policy import EndpointPolicyError  # noqa: E402
+from loa_cheval.config.loader import clear_config_cache, load_config  # noqa: E402
+from loa_cheval.types import ConfigError  # noqa: E402
+
+REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
+EXAMPLE = REPO_ROOT / ".loa.config.yaml.example"
+DEFAULTS = REPO_ROOT / ".claude" / "defaults" / "model-config.yaml"
+
+_BEGIN = re.compile(r"^#\s*@example-begin\s+([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)\s*$")
+_END = re.compile(r"^#\s*@example-end\s*$")
+
+
+def extract_examples(text: str) -> List[Tuple[str, str]]:
+    """(name, uncommented YAML) for every marked block. One leading `#` and one
+    following space are removed per line; a nested or unterminated block fails."""
+    blocks: List[Tuple[str, str]] = []
+    name = None
+    lines: List[str] = []
+    for raw in text.splitlines():
+        if name is None:
+            m = _BEGIN.match(raw)
+            if m:
+                name, lines = m.group(1), []
+            elif _END.match(raw):
+                raise AssertionError("@example-end without @example-begin")
+            continue
+        if _BEGIN.match(raw):
+            raise AssertionError(f"nested @example-begin inside {name}")
+        if _END.match(raw):
+            blocks.append((name, "\n".join(lines) + "\n"))
+            name = None
+            continue
+        assert raw.startswith("#"), f"example {name}: every line must be commented: {raw!r}"
+        body = raw[1:]
+        lines.append(body[1:] if body.startswith(" ") else body)
+    assert name is None, f"unterminated example block {name}"
+    return blocks
+
+
+def _project(tmp_path: Path, hounfour: Dict[str, Any]) -> str:
+    root = tmp_path / "proj"
+    (root / ".claude" / "defaults").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    shutil.copy(DEFAULTS, root / ".claude" / "defaults" / "model-config.yaml")
+    (root / ".loa.config.yaml").write_text(yaml.safe_dump({"hounfour": hounfour}, sort_keys=False))
+    return str(root)
+
+
+def _load(tmp_path: Path, hounfour: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    clear_config_cache()
+    merged, _ = load_config(project_root=_project(tmp_path, hounfour))
+    return merged
+
+
+EXAMPLES = extract_examples(EXAMPLE.read_text())
+_BY_NAME = {n: yaml.safe_load(y)["hounfour"] for n, y in EXAMPLES}
+
+
+def test_marked_examples_are_present():
+    names = [n for n, _ in EXAMPLES]
+    assert len(names) == len(set(names)), names
+    for required in ("conservative", "budget-conscious", "azure-openai", "local-openai-compatible"):
+        assert required in names, f"example {required} is not marked in {EXAMPLE.name}"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("name, body", EXAMPLES, ids=[n for n, _ in EXAMPLES])
+def test_every_marked_example_loads(tmp_path, name, body):
+    doc = yaml.safe_load(body)
+    assert isinstance(doc, dict) and "hounfour" in doc, f"example {name} must be a `hounfour:` block"
+    merged = _load(tmp_path, doc["hounfour"])

+# --- refusals at load ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

+def _local(**overrides: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]:

+REFUSALS = [

+     "ENDPOINT-INSECURE-SCHEME"),

+     "ENDPOINT-OPTIN-DNS-NAME"),

+     "ENDPOINT-OPTIN-LINK-LOCAL"),

+     "ENDPOINT-INSECURE-HOST-MISMATCH"),

+

+"""cycle-129 FR-7 (SDD D-7.2; sprint-257 Task 3.1, AC-3.1) — the per-provider
+insecure-endpoint opt-in on BOTH paths, and the request-time rules.
+
+* One case table runs through the bash-path validator
+  (`.claude/scripts/lib/endpoint-validator.py` `validate(..., allow_insecure_endpoint=...)`)
+  and the cheval Python path (`loa_cheval.config.endpoint_policy.check_endpoint`); the two
+  must agree on accept/refuse and on the refusal code.
+* D-7.2 test list: IPv4 and IPv6 loopback accepted, RFC1918 accepted, link-local and metadata
+  refused, DNS name refused, boolean refused, cross-provider isolation, and — at request time
+  against a stub server bound to 127.0.0.1 — redirect refused, proxy env ignored, path prefix
+  enforced, on the httpx and the urllib transport.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import importlib.util
+import json
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import threading
+from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+import pytest
+
+sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
+
+from loa_cheval.config.endpoint_policy import EndpointPolicyError, check_endpoint  # noqa: E402
+from loa_cheval.providers import base  # noqa: E402
+from loa_cheval.providers.base import TransportPolicy, http_get, http_post, http_post_stream  # noqa: E402
+from loa_cheval.types import InvalidConfigError  # noqa: E402
+
+REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
+VALIDATOR_PATH = REPO_ROOT / ".claude" / "scripts" / "lib" / "endpoint-validator.py"
+ALLOWLIST_PATH = REPO_ROOT / ".claude" / "scripts" / "lib" / "allowlists" / "loa-providers.json"
+
+
+def _load_validator():
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("endpoint_validator_under_test", VALIDATOR_PATH)
+    mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    assert spec.loader is not None
+    sys.modules[spec.name] = mod
+    spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
+    return mod
+
+
+EV = _load_validator()
+ALLOWLIST = EV.load_allowlist(ALLOWLIST_PATH)
+
+OK = None
+# (case id, url, allow_insecure_endpoint, expected refusal code or OK)
+CASES = [
+    ("ipv4-loopback", "http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1", "127.0.0.1", OK),
+    ("ipv4-loopback-other-127", "http://127.0.0.2:8000/v1", "127.0.0.2", OK),
+    ("ipv6-loopback", "http://[::1]:8000/v1", "::1", OK),
+    ("ipv6-loopback-bracketed-optin", "http://[::1]:8000/v1", "[::1]", OK),
+    ("localhost", "http://localhost:11434/v1", "localhost", OK),
+    ("rfc1918-10", "http://10.0.0.7:8000/v1", "10.0.0.7", OK),
+    ("rfc1918-172-16", "http://172.16.5.5:8000/v1", "172.16.5.5", OK),
+    ("rfc1918-192-168", "http://192.168.0.10:8000/v1", "192.168.0.10", OK),
+    ("https-to-optin-host", "https://192.168.0.10/v1", "192.168.0.10", OK),
+    ("link-local-v4", "http://169.254.7.7/v1", "169.254.7.7", "ENDPOINT-OPTIN-LINK-LOCAL"),
+    ("link-local-v6", "http://[fe80::1]/v1", "fe80::1", "ENDPOINT-OPTIN-LINK-LOCAL"),
+    ("metadata-v4", "http://169.254.169.254/latest", "169.254.169.254", "ENDPOINT-OPTIN-METADATA"),
+    ("metadata-v6", "http://[fd00:ec2::254]/latest", "fd00:ec2::254", "ENDPOINT-OPTIN-METADATA"),
+    ("dns-name", "http://llm.lan:8000/v1", "llm.lan", "ENDPOINT-OPTIN-DNS-NAME"),
+    ("public-v4", "http://8.8.8.8/v1", "8.8.8.8", "ENDPOINT-OPTIN-NOT-LOCAL"),
+    ("ipv6-unique-local", "http://[fd12:3456::1]/v1", "fd12:3456::1", "ENDPOINT-OPTIN-NOT-LOCAL"),
+    ("cgnat-not-rfc1918", "http://100.64.0.1/v1", "100.64.0.1", "ENDPOINT-OPTIN-NOT-LOCAL"),
+    ("boolean-true", "http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1", True, "ENDPOINT-OPTIN-BOOLEAN"),
+    ("boolean-false", "http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1", False, "ENDPOINT-OPTIN-BOOLEAN"),
+    ("optin-with-port", "http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1", "127.0.0.1:8000", "ENDPOINT-OPTIN-DNS-NAME"),
+    ("optin-with-scheme", "http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1", "http://127.0.0.1", "ENDPOINT-OPTIN-INVALID"),
+    ("mismatched-host", "http://localhost:8000/v1", "127.0.0.1", "ENDPOINT-INSECURE-HOST-MISMATCH"),
+    ("mismatched-public", "http://8.8.8.8/v1", "127.0.0.1", "ENDPOINT-INSECURE-HOST-MISMATCH"),
+    ("http-no-optin-loopback", "http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1", None, "ENDPOINT-INSECURE-SCHEME"),
+    ("http-no-optin-public", "http://8.8.8.8/v1", None, "ENDPOINT-INSECURE-SCHEME"),
+    ("https-no-optin-loopback", "https://127.0.0.1/v1", None, "ENDPOINT-IP-BLOCKED"),
+    ("https-no-optin-rfc1918", "https://10.0.0.1/v1", None, "ENDPOINT-IP-BLOCKED"),
+    ("https-no-optin-metadata", "https://169.254.169.254/", None, "ENDPOINT-IP-BLOCKED"),
+    ("https-no-optin-v6-loopback", "https://[::1]/v1", None, "ENDPOINT-IPV6-BLOCKED"),
+    ("userinfo-on-optin-host", "http://user:pw@127.0.0.1:8000/v1", "127.0.0.1", "ENDPOINT-USERINFO-PRESENT"),
+]
+
+
+def _cheval(url: str, optin: Any) -> Optional[str]:
+    try:
+        check_endpoint(url, optin, "p")
+    except EndpointPolicyError as exc:
+        return exc.policy_code
+    return OK
+
+
+def _bash_path(url: str, optin: Any) -> Optional[str]:
+    result = EV.validate(url, ALLOWLIST, allow_insecure_endpoint=optin)
+    return OK if result.valid else result.code
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("case, url, optin, expected", CASES, ids=[c[0] for c in CASES])
+def test_both_paths_agree(case, url, optin, expected):
+    assert _cheval(url, optin) == expected, f"cheval path: {case}"
+    assert _bash_path(url, optin) == expected, f"endpoint-validator.py: {case}"
+
+
+def test_validator_cli_flag_admits_only_the_optin_host():
+    def run(*args: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess:
+        return subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", str(VALIDATOR_PATH), "--allowlist", str(ALLOWLIST_PATH), *args],
+                              capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
+
+    ok = run("--allow-insecure-endpoint", "127.0.0.1", "--json", "http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/models")
+    assert ok.returncode == 0, ok.stderr
+    assert json.loads(ok.stdout)["extra"] == {"insecure_optin": "127.0.0.1"}
+    refused = run("--allow-insecure-endpoint", "true", "http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/models")
+    assert refused.returncode == 78 and "ENDPOINT-OPTIN-DNS-NAME" in refused.stderr
+    no_optin = run("http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/models")
+    assert no_optin.returncode == 78 and "ENDPOINT-INSECURE-SCHEME" in no_optin.stderr
+
+
+def test_cross_provider_isolation_on_both_paths():
+    """Provider A's opt-in is passed with A's URL only; provider B (same loopback host, no
+    opt-in of its own) keeps every refusal on both paths, before and after A is validated."""
+    a_url, a_optin = "http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1", "127.0.0.1"
+    b_url = "http://127.0.0.1:9000/v1"
+    for _ in range(2):
+        assert _cheval(a_url, a_optin) is OK and _bash_path(a_url, a_optin) is OK
+        assert _cheval(b_url, None) == "ENDPOINT-INSECURE-SCHEME"
+        assert _bash_path(b_url, None) == "ENDPOINT-INSECURE-SCHEME"
+    # the hosted provider's https URL is untouched by A's opt-in
+    assert _bash_path("https://api.openai.com/v1", None) is OK
+    assert _bash_path("https://api.openai.com/v1", a_optin) is OK
+
+
+# --- request time: a stub server on 127.0.0.1 -------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+class _Stub:
+    """127.0.0.1 HTTP server the test starts and stops. Paths: /v1/ok (200 JSON),
+    /v1/redirect (302 to /v1/ok), /v1/stream (one SSE chunk). Records request headers."""
+
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        stub = self
+        self.seen: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
+
+        class H(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
+            def _reply(self) -> None:
+                length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0)
+                if length:
+                    self.rfile.read(length)
+                stub.seen.append({"path": self.path, "headers": dict(self.headers)})
+                if self.path.endswith("/redirect"):
+                    self.send_response(302)
+                    self.send_header("Location", f"http://127.0.0.1:{stub.port}/v1/ok")
+                    self.send_header("Content-Length", "0")
+                    self.end_headers()
+                    return
+                payload = b'{"ok": true}'
+                self.send_response(200)
+                self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
+                self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(payload)))
+                self.end_headers()
+                self.wfile.write(payload)
+
+            do_GET = _reply
+            do_POST = _reply
+
+            def log_message(self, *args: Any) -> None:
+                pass
+
+        self.server = HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), H)
+        self.port = self.server.server_port
+        self.thread = threading.Thread(target=self.server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
+
+    def __enter__(self) -> "_Stub":
+        self.thread.start()
+        return self
+
+    def __exit__(self, *exc: Any) -> None:
+        self.server.shutdown()
+        self.server.server_close()
+
+    @property
+    def endpoint(self) -> str:
+        return f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.port}/v1"
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(params=["httpx", "urllib"])
+def transport(request, monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(base, "_HTTP_CLIENT", request.param)
+    yield request.param
+    base._reset_http_client_detection_for_tests()
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def stub():
+    with _Stub() as s:
+        yield s
+
+
+def _policy(s: _Stub) -> TransportPolicy:
+    return TransportPolicy(endpoint=s.endpoint, provider="local")
+
+
+def test_redirect_refused(transport, stub):
+    with pytest.raises(InvalidConfigError, match="redirect refused"):
+        http_post(f"{stub.endpoint}/redirect", {}, {"x": 1}, policy=_policy(stub))
+    with pytest.raises(InvalidConfigError, match="redirect refused"):
+        http_get(f"{stub.endpoint}/redirect", {}, policy=_policy(stub))
+    with pytest.raises(InvalidConfigError, match="redirect refused"):
+        with http_post_stream(f"{stub.endpoint}/redirect", {}, {"x": 1}, policy=_policy(stub)):
+            pass
+    # never followed: the stub saw only the redirecting request, never /v1/ok
+    assert all(r["path"].endswith("/redirect") for r in stub.seen)
+
+
+_PROXY_VARS = ("HTTP_PROXY", "HTTPS_PROXY", "ALL_PROXY", "http_proxy", "https_proxy", "all_proxy")
+
+
+def test_proxy_env_ignored(transport, stub, monkeypatch):
+    import urllib.request
+
+    for var in ("NO_PROXY", "no_proxy"):
+        monkeypatch.delenv(var, raising=False)
+    for var in _PROXY_VARS:
+        monkeypatch.setenv(var, "http://127.0.0.1:1")   # a dead proxy: any use of it fails
+    # urllib caches a process-wide default opener whose ProxyHandler read the env when it
+    # was built; drop it so the no-policy control below sees this test's proxy env.
+    monkeypatch.setattr(urllib.request, "_opener", None)
+    status, body = http_post(f"{stub.endpoint}/ok", {}, {"x": 1}, policy=_policy(stub))
+    assert (status, body) == (200, {"ok": True})
+    status, _ = http_get(f"{stub.endpoint}/ok", {}, policy=_policy(stub))
+    assert status == 200
+    with http_post_stream(f"{stub.endpoint}/ok", {}, {"x": 1}, policy=_policy(stub)) as resp:
+        assert resp.status_code == 200 and b"".join(resp.iter_bytes()) == b'{"ok": true}'
+    # control: without the policy the same call goes to the dead proxy and never reaches the stub
+    seen_before = len(stub.seen)
+    try:
+        control_status: Optional[int] = http_post(f"{stub.endpoint}/ok", {}, {"x": 1})[0]
+    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 — httpx raises ConnectionLostError; urllib returns 503
+        control_status = None
+    assert control_status != 200
+    assert len(stub.seen) == seen_before
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("url", [
+    "/other/chat/completions",          # outside the declared path
+    "/v10/chat/completions",            # a sibling that only shares the prefix string
+    "/v1/../admin",                     # traversal
+])
+def test_path_prefix_enforced(stub, url):
+    with pytest.raises(InvalidConfigError, match="outside the declared endpoint"):
+        http_post(f"http://127.0.0.1:{stub.port}{url}", {}, {}, policy=_policy(stub))
+    assert stub.seen == []
+
+
+def test_origin_must_match(stub):
+    pol = _policy(stub)
+    for url in (f"http://127.0.0.1:{stub.port + 1}/v1/x", f"http://localhost:{stub.port}/v1/x",
+                f"https://127.0.0.1:{stub.port}/v1/x"):
+        with pytest.raises(InvalidConfigError):
+            pol.check_url(url)
+    pol.check_url(f"{stub.endpoint}/chat/completions")
+    pol.check_url(stub.endpoint)
+
+
+def test_opted_in_adapter_sends_no_credential_and_uses_the_policy(stub, monkeypatch):
+    """A keyless opted-in provider: the OpenAI adapter's request carries no Authorization
+    header and goes through the TransportPolicy (dead proxy env set; still reaches the stub)."""
+    from loa_cheval.providers.openai_adapter import OpenAIAdapter
+    from loa_cheval.types import CompletionRequest, ModelConfig, ProviderConfig
+
+    for var in _PROXY_VARS:
+        monkeypatch.setenv(var, "http://127.0.0.1:1")
+    monkeypatch.setenv("LOA_CHEVAL_DISABLE_STREAMING", "1")
+    cfg = ProviderConfig(
+        name="local", type="openai_compat", endpoint=stub.endpoint, auth="",
+        keyless=True, allow_insecure_endpoint="127.0.0.1",
+        models={"m": ModelConfig(capabilities=["chat"], context_window=32768, endpoint_family="chat",
+                                 dispatch_group="local")},
+    )
+    adapter = OpenAIAdapter(cfg)
+    assert adapter.validate_config() == []
+    # the stub answers {"ok": true}: no `choices`, so the parse fails AFTER the request
+    with pytest.raises(Exception, match="no choices"):
+        adapter.complete(CompletionRequest(messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "hi"}], model="m", max_tokens=16))
+    assert len(stub.seen) == 1
+    assert stub.seen[0]["path"] == "/v1/chat/completions"
+    assert "Authorization" not in stub.seen[0]["headers"]

+"""cycle-129 FR-7 (SDD D-7.3, §6; sprint-257 Task 3.2, AC-3.2) — structured output on
+the OpenAI chat-completions path.
+
+* `_build_chat_body` carries `response_format: {type: json_schema, json_schema: {name,
+  schema, strict: true}}` when the request has an output schema AND the model entry
+  declares `structured_json`; absent otherwise.
+* `schema_enforced` in the result metadata is True only when the body sent carried it.
+* An HTTP 400 whose body names `response_format`/`json_schema` is retried once without
+  the schema and recorded (`schema_enforced: False`, `schema_rejected_by_server: True`);
+  any other 400 is not retried. Streaming and non-streaming transports both.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sys
+from contextlib import contextmanager
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any, Dict, List
+
+import pytest
+
+sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
+
+from loa_cheval.providers import openai_adapter as oa  # noqa: E402
+from loa_cheval.providers.openai_adapter import OpenAIAdapter  # noqa: E402
+from loa_cheval.types import CompletionRequest, InvalidInputError, ModelConfig, ProviderConfig  # noqa: E402
+
+SCHEMA = {"type": "object", "properties": {"findings": {"type": "array"}}, "required": ["findings"],
+          "additionalProperties": False}
+
+
+def _cfg(caps: List[str]) -> ProviderConfig:
+    return ProviderConfig(
+        name="local", type="openai_compat", endpoint="http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1", auth="", keyless=True,
+        allow_insecure_endpoint="127.0.0.1",
+        models={"m": ModelConfig(capabilities=caps, context_window=32768, endpoint_family="chat",
+                                 dispatch_group="local")},
+    )
+
+
+def _req(schema: Any = SCHEMA) -> CompletionRequest:
+    meta = {"output_schema_name": "adversarial-finding.wire.json"} if schema is not None else {}
+    return CompletionRequest(messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "review"}], model="m", max_tokens=64,
+                             output_schema=schema, metadata=meta)
+
+
+# --- body ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def test_chat_body_carries_response_format_for_a_structured_json_entry():
+    adapter = OpenAIAdapter(_cfg(["chat", "structured_json"]))
+    body = adapter._build_chat_body(_req(), adapter._get_model_config("m"))
+    assert body["response_format"] == {
+        "type": "json_schema",
+        "json_schema": {"name": "adversarial-finding", "schema": SCHEMA, "strict": True},
+    }
+    assert oa._schema_enforced(body) is True
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("caps, schema", [(["chat"], SCHEMA), (["chat", "structured_json"], None)],
+                         ids=["no-structured_json-capability", "no-schema-requested"])
+def test_chat_body_has_no_response_format_otherwise(caps, schema):
+    adapter = OpenAIAdapter(_cfg(caps))
+    body = adapter._build_chat_body(_req(schema), adapter._get_model_config("m"))
+    assert "response_format" not in body
+    assert oa._schema_enforced(body) is False
+
+
+# --- schema_enforced truth through complete() -----------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def _ok_chat() -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    return {"choices": [{"message": {"content": '{"findings": []}'}}], "model": "m",
+            "usage": {"prompt_tokens": 3, "completion_tokens": 4}}
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("caps, expected", [(["chat", "structured_json"], True), (["chat"], False)])
+def test_schema_enforced_is_true_only_when_the_body_carried_it(monkeypatch, caps, expected):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("LOA_CHEVAL_DISABLE_STREAMING", "1")
+    sent: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
+
+    def fake_post(url, headers, body, connect_timeout=10.0, read_timeout=120.0, policy=None):
+        sent.append(body)
+        return 200, _ok_chat()
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(oa, "http_post", fake_post)
+    result = OpenAIAdapter(_cfg(caps)).complete(_req())
+    assert ("response_format" in sent[0]) is expected
+    assert result.metadata["schema_enforced"] is expected
+    assert "schema_rejected_by_server" not in result.metadata
+
+
+# --- the 400 retry ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+_REJECTIONS = [
+    {"error": {"message": "response_format json_schema is not supported by this server", "type": "BadRequestError"}},
+    {"object": "error", "message": "Unknown field: json_schema", "code": 400},
+    {"detail": [{"loc": ["body", "response_format"], "msg": "extra fields not permitted"}]},
+]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("rejection", _REJECTIONS, ids=["openai-shape", "vllm-shape", "fastapi-shape"])
+def test_non_streaming_400_naming_response_format_retries_once_without_it(monkeypatch, rejection):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("LOA_CHEVAL_DISABLE_STREAMING", "1")
+    sent: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
+    replies = [(400, rejection), (200, _ok_chat())]
+
+    def fake_post(url, headers, body, connect_timeout=10.0, read_timeout=120.0, policy=None):
+        sent.append(dict(body))
+        return replies.pop(0)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(oa, "http_post", fake_post)
+    result = OpenAIAdapter(_cfg(["chat", "structured_json"])).complete(_req())
+    assert len(sent) == 2
+    assert "response_format" in sent[0] and "response_format" not in sent[1]
+    assert result.metadata["schema_enforced"] is False
+    assert result.metadata["schema_rejected_by_server"] is True
+    assert result.content == '{"findings": []}'
+
+
+def test_a_400_not_naming_response_format_is_not_retried(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("LOA_CHEVAL_DISABLE_STREAMING", "1")
+    sent: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
+
+    def fake_post(url, headers, body, connect_timeout=10.0, read_timeout=120.0, policy=None):
+        sent.append(body)
+        return 400, {"error": {"message": "max_tokens is too large"}}
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(oa, "http_post", fake_post)
+    with pytest.raises(InvalidInputError, match="max_tokens is too large"):
+        OpenAIAdapter(_cfg(["chat", "structured_json"])).complete(_req())
+    assert len(sent) == 1
+
+
+def test_a_second_rejection_is_not_retried_again(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("LOA_CHEVAL_DISABLE_STREAMING", "1")
+    sent: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
+
+    def fake_post(url, headers, body, connect_timeout=10.0, read_timeout=120.0, policy=None):
+        sent.append(body)
+        return 400, {"error": {"message": "response_format unsupported"}}
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(oa, "http_post", fake_post)
+    with pytest.raises(InvalidInputError):
+        OpenAIAdapter(_cfg(["chat", "structured_json"])).complete(_req())
+    assert len(sent) == 2   # the original and exactly one retry without the schema
+
+
+class _FakeStream:
+    def __init__(self, status: int, chunks: List[bytes]):
+        self.status_code = status
+        self._chunks = chunks
+
+    def iter_bytes(self):
+        return iter(self._chunks)
+
+
+def test_streaming_400_naming_response_format_retries_once_without_it(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.delenv("LOA_CHEVAL_DISABLE_STREAMING", raising=False)
+    sent: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
+    ok_sse = [
+        b'data: {"choices":[{"delta":{"content":"{\\"findings\\": []}"},"finish_reason":null}],"model":"m"}\n\n',
+        b'data: {"choices":[{"delta":{},"finish_reason":"stop"}],"model":"m"}\n\n',
+        b"data: [DONE]\n\n",
+    ]
+    replies = [_FakeStream(400, [b'{"error":{"message":"response_format is not supported"}}']),
+               _FakeStream(200, ok_sse)]
+
+    @contextmanager
+    def fake_stream(url, headers, body, connect_timeout=10.0, read_timeout=120.0, policy=None):
+        sent.append(dict(body))
+        yield replies.pop(0)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(oa, "http_post_stream", fake_stream)
+    result = OpenAIAdapter(_cfg(["chat", "structured_json"])).complete(_req())
+    assert len(sent) == 2
+    assert "response_format" in sent[0] and "response_format" not in sent[1]
+    assert result.metadata["schema_enforced"] is False
+    assert result.metadata["schema_rejected_by_server"] is True
+    assert result.content == '{"findings": []}'
+
+
+def test_the_heuristic():
+    assert oa._names_response_format(400, {"error": {"message": "bad RESPONSE_FORMAT"}})
+    assert oa._names_response_format(400, "json_schema: unsupported")
+    assert not oa._names_response_format(422, {"error": {"message": "response_format"}})
+    assert not oa._names_response_format(400, {"error": {"message": "context length exceeded"}})

+"""cycle-129 FR-7 / FR-8 (SDD D-7.2, D-7.3, D-8.0; sprint-257 Task 3.2, AC-3.2) — a local
+OpenAI-compatible hop end to end through `cheval.cmd_invoke`, the real loader and the real
+OpenAI adapter, against a stub server the test binds to 127.0.0.1 and stops.
+
+* The stub streams `reasoning_content` deltas, then a `<think>`-prefixed answer: the
+  answer printed is the JSON alone, and the MODELINV row records `thinking_stripped`,
+  `schema_enforced` (response_format carried for a `structured_json` entry),
+  `destination: {host, scheme, provider}`, `locality_mode` and `hop_locality: local`.
+* A stub that rejects `response_format` with HTTP 400: one retry without it,
+  `schema_enforced: false`, `schema_rejected_by_server: true`.
+* A prompt over the declared `context_window` refuses the hop with
+  `context_window exceeded (<n> > <limit>) for <alias>`, writes a MODELINV row with
+  `failure_class: context_window_refused`, and sends nothing to the server.
+* A hosted hop records `hop_locality: hosted` and its https destination.
+
+Every MODELINV payload captured here is validated against the shipped payload schema.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import copy
+import json
+import shutil
+import sys
+import threading
+import types
+from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import jsonschema
+import pytest
+import yaml
+
+sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))
+
+import cheval  # type: ignore[import-not-found]  # noqa: E402
+from loa_cheval.config.loader import clear_config_cache, load_config  # noqa: E402
+
+REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
+DEFAULTS = REPO_ROOT / ".claude" / "defaults" / "model-config.yaml"
+PAYLOAD_SCHEMA = (REPO_ROOT / ".claude" / "data" / "trajectory-schemas" / "model-events"
+                  / "model-invoke-complete.payload.schema.json")
+WIRE_SCHEMA = {"type": "object", "properties": {"findings": {"type": "array"}}, "required": ["findings"]}
+
+
+def _payload_validator() -> jsonschema.Draft202012Validator:
+    schema = json.loads(PAYLOAD_SCHEMA.read_text())
+    # the error_class enum lives in a sibling schema behind a loa:// $ref; a string suffices here
+    schema["properties"]["models_failed"]["items"]["properties"]["error_class"] = {"type": "string"}
+    return jsonschema.Draft202012Validator(schema)
+
+
+VALIDATOR = _payload_validator()
+
+
+# --- the stub server -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+class _Stub:
+    def __init__(self, mode: str = "stream-think") -> None:
+        stub = self
+        self.mode = mode
+        self.requests: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
+
+        class H(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
+            protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"
+
+            def do_POST(self) -> None:  # noqa: N802
+                length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0)
+                body = json.loads(self.rfile.read(length) or b"{}")
+                stub.requests.append({"path": self.path, "headers": dict(self.headers), "body": body})
+                if stub.mode == "reject-schema" and "response_format" in body:
+                    payload = json.dumps({"object": "error", "message": "response_format json_schema unsupported",
+                                          "code": 400}).encode()
+                    self.send_response(400)
+                    self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
+                    self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(payload)))
+                    self.end_headers()
+                    self.wfile.write(payload)
+                    return
+                events = [
+                    {"choices": [{"delta": {"role": "assistant", "reasoning_content": "Reading the diff. "}}]},
+                    {"choices": [{"delta": {"reasoning_content": "Nothing is wrong."}}]},
+                    {"choices": [{"delta": {"content": "<think>double-check</think>"}}]},
+                    {"choices": [{"delta": {"content": '{"findings": []}'}}]},
+                    {"choices": [{"delta": {}, "finish_reason": "stop"}]},
+                    {"choices": [], "usage": {"prompt_tokens": 12, "completion_tokens": 7}},
+                ]
+                raw = b"".join(f"data: {json.dumps(dict(e, model='qwen3-coder-30b'))}\n\n".encode() for e in events)
+                raw += b"data: [DONE]\n\n"
+                self.send_response(200)
+                self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/event-stream")
+                self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(raw)))
+                self.end_headers()
+                self.wfile.write(raw)
+
+            def log_message(self, *args: Any) -> None:
+                pass
+
+        self.server = HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), H)
+        self.port = self.server.server_port
+        self.thread = threading.Thread(target=self.server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
+        self.thread.start()
+
+    def stop(self) -> None:
+        self.server.shutdown()
+        self.server.server_close()
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def stub():
+    s = _Stub()
+    yield s
+    s.stop()
+
+
+# --- harness -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def _local_hounfour(port: int, *, context_window: int = 32768, caps: Optional[List[str]] = None,
+                    locality: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    h: Dict[str, Any] = {
+        "providers": {
+            "local": {
+                "type": "openai_compat",
+                "endpoint": f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/v1",
+                "keyless": True,
+                "allow_insecure_endpoint": "127.0.0.1",
+                "models": {
+                    "qwen3-coder-30b": {
+                        "endpoint_family": "chat", "auth_type": "http_api", "dispatch_group": "local",
+                        "capabilities": caps or ["chat", "structured_json"],
+                        "context_window": context_window, "max_output_tokens": 512,
+                        "streaming_recovery": {"first_token_deadline_s": 120},
+                        "pricing": {"input_per_mtok": 0, "output_per_mtok": 0},
+                    }
+                },
+            }
+        },
+        "aliases": {"local-reviewer": "local:qwen3-coder-30b"},
+        "feature_flags": {"metering": False},
+    }
+    if locality:
+        h["locality"] = locality
+    return h
+
+
+def _merged(tmp_path: Path, hounfour: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    root = tmp_path / "proj"
+    (root / ".claude" / "defaults").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    shutil.copy(DEFAULTS, root / ".claude" / "defaults" / "model-config.yaml")
+    (root / ".loa.config.yaml").write_text(yaml.safe_dump({"hounfour": hounfour}, sort_keys=False))
+    clear_config_cache()
+    merged, _ = load_config(project_root=str(root))
+    return merged
+
+
+def _args(prompt: str, *, model: str = "local-reviewer", json_schema: Optional[str] = None) -> Any:
+    a = types.SimpleNamespace()
+    a.agent = "flatline-reviewer"
+    a.role = None
+    a.skill = None
+    a.sprint_kind = None
+    a.input = None
+    a.prompt = prompt
+    a.system = None
+    a.model = model
+    a.max_tokens = 256
+    a.output_format = "text"
+    a.json_errors = True
+    a.timeout = 30
+    a.include_thinking = False
+    a.async_mode = False
+    a.poll_id = None
+    a.cancel_id = None
+    a.dry_run = False
+    a.print_config = False
+    a.validate_bindings = False
+    a.mock_fixture_dir = None
+    a.max_input_tokens = None
+    a.json_schema = json_schema
+    a.effort = None
+    return a
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
+def _quiet(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(cheval, "_load_persona", lambda *_a, **_kw: None)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(cheval, "_load_persona_parts", lambda *_a, **_kw: (None, None))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(cheval, "_check_feature_flags", lambda *_a, **_kw: None)
+    for var in ("HTTP_PROXY", "HTTPS_PROXY", "ALL_PROXY", "http_proxy", "https_proxy", "all_proxy"):
+        monkeypatch.setenv(var, "http://127.0.0.1:1")   # a dead proxy: the local hop must ignore it
+    monkeypatch.delenv("LOA_CHEVAL_DISABLE_STREAMING", raising=False)
+    from loa_cheval.providers import base
+    base._reset_http_client_detection_for_tests()
+
+
+def _invoke(merged: Dict[str, Any], args: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    captured: Dict[str, Any] = {}
+
+    def fake_emit(level, event, payload, *_a, **_kw):
+        captured.update(copy.deepcopy(payload))
+
+    with patch.object(cheval, "load_config", return_value=(merged, {})), \
+         patch("loa_cheval.audit_envelope.audit_emit", fake_emit), \
+         patch("loa_cheval.audit.modelinv.redact_payload_strings", side_effect=lambda x: x), \
+         patch("loa_cheval.audit.modelinv.assert_no_secret_shapes_remain"):
+        captured["__exit__"] = cheval.cmd_invoke(args)
+    return captured
+
+
+def _assert_schema_valid(payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    body = {k: v for k, v in payload.items() if k != "__exit__"}
+    errors = sorted(VALIDATOR.iter_errors(body), key=lambda e: list(e.path))
+    assert not errors, [f"{list(e.path)}: {e.message}" for e in errors]
+
+
+# --- tests -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def test_local_hop_streams_reasoning_strips_think_and_records_destination(tmp_path, stub, capsys):
+    schema_file = tmp_path / "adversarial-finding.wire.json"
+    schema_file.write_text(json.dumps(WIRE_SCHEMA))
+    merged = _merged(tmp_path, _local_hounfour(stub.port))
+    row = _invoke(merged, _args("Review this diff: x = 1", json_schema=str(schema_file)))
+    out = capsys.readouterr()
+    assert row["__exit__"] == 0, out.err
+    assert out.out.strip() == '{"findings": []}'          # no reasoning, no <think>
+    req = stub.requests[0]
+    assert req["path"] == "/v1/chat/completions"
+    assert "Authorization" not in req["headers"]
+    assert req["body"]["response_format"]["type"] == "json_schema"
+    assert req["body"]["response_format"]["json_schema"]["strict"] is True
+    assert row["models_succeeded"] == ["local:qwen3-coder-30b"]
+    assert row["schema_enforced"] is True
+    assert row["thinking_stripped"] is True
+    assert row["destination"] == {"host": f"127.0.0.1:{stub.port}", "scheme": "http", "provider": "local"}
+    assert row["locality_mode"] == "hosted"
+    assert row["hop_locality"] == "local"
+    assert "schema_rejected_by_server" not in row
+    _assert_schema_valid(row)
+
+
+def test_server_rejecting_response_format_is_retried_once_and_recorded(tmp_path, capsys):
+    s = _Stub(mode="reject-schema")
+    try:
+        schema_file = tmp_path / "adversarial-finding.wire.json"
+        schema_file.write_text(json.dumps(WIRE_SCHEMA))
+        merged = _merged(tmp_path, _local_hounfour(s.port, locality="local_voices"))
+        row = _invoke(merged, _args("Review this diff", json_schema=str(schema_file)))
+    finally:
+        s.stop()
+    out = capsys.readouterr()
+    assert row["__exit__"] == 0, out.err
+    assert [("response_format" in r["body"]) for r in s.requests] == [True, False]
+    assert row["schema_enforced"] is False
+    assert row["schema_rejected_by_server"] is True
+    assert row["locality_mode"] == "local_voices"
+    _assert_schema_valid(row)
+
+
+def test_prompt_over_the_declared_context_window_refuses_the_hop(tmp_path, stub, capsys):
+    merged = _merged(tmp_path, _local_hounfour(stub.port, context_window=600))
+    row = _invoke(merged, _args("word " * 4000))
+    err = capsys.readouterr().err
+    assert row["__exit__"] == cheval.EXIT_CODES["CONTEXT_TOO_LARGE"], err
+    assert stub.requests == []                               # nothing sent, nothing truncated
+    failed = row["models_failed"]
+    assert len(failed) == 1
+    assert failed[0]["failure_class"] == "context_window_refused"
+    assert failed[0]["error_class"] == "ROUTING_MISS"
+    assert failed[0]["message_redacted"].startswith("context_window exceeded (")
+    assert "> 344) for local-reviewer" in failed[0]["message_redacted"]   # 600 − 256 reserved output
+    assert "context_window exceeded" in err
+    assert row["destination"]["provider"] == "local" and row["hop_locality"] == "local"
+    _assert_schema_valid(row)
+
+
+def test_hosted_hop_records_hosted_locality_and_https_destination(tmp_path):
+    merged = _merged(tmp_path, {})
+    from loa_cheval.audit.modelinv import hop_telemetry
+    t = hop_telemetry("openai:gpt-5.5", merged)
+    assert t == {"locality_mode": "hosted", "hop_locality": "hosted",
+                 "destination": {"host": "api.openai.com", "scheme": "https", "provider": "openai"}}
+    cli = hop_telemetry("openai:codex-headless", merged)
+    assert cli["destination"] == {"host": "cli-subprocess", "scheme": "cli", "provider": "openai"}
+    assert hop_telemetry(None, merged) == {"locality_mode": "hosted"}
+    assert hop_telemetry("openai:gpt-5.5", dict(merged, locality="bogus")).get("locality_mode") is None

+"""cycle-129 FR-7 (SDD D-7.3; sprint-257 Task 3.2, AC-3.2) — thinking traces from local
+reasoning models on the OpenAI paths.
+
+* Streamed `delta.reasoning_content` deltas count as progress for the recovery tracker
+  (they satisfy the first-token deadline) and never reach `content`; they land in
+  `thinking`.
+* Leading `<think>…</think>` blocks and an unterminated leading `<think>` are stripped
+  from the content before qualification on the streaming and the non-streaming path;
+  `thinking_stripped` is recorded in the result metadata (cheval copies it to MODELINV).
+* The model's `streaming_recovery` block reaches the stream parser.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import sys
+from contextlib import contextmanager
+from pathlib import Path

+from loa_cheval.types import CompletionRequest, ModelConfig, ProviderConfig  # noqa: E402

+
+def _sse(*payloads: Dict[str, Any]) -> List[bytes]:
+    return [f"data: {json.dumps(p)}\n\n".encode() for p in payloads] + [b"data: [DONE]\n\n"]
+
+
+def _delta(**delta: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    return {"choices": [{"delta": delta, "finish_reason": None}], "model": "m"}
+
+
+class _Clock:
+    """Advances `step` seconds on every read — each SSE event costs `step` seconds."""
+
+    def __init__(self, step: float):
+        self.t = 0.0
+        self.step = step
+
+    def __call__(self) -> float:
+        self.t += self.step
+        return self.t
+
+
+SLOW = {"streaming_recovery": {"first_token_deadline_s": 5}}
+
+
+def test_reasoning_deltas_keep_the_tracker_alive_and_never_reach_content():
+    chunks = _sse(
+        _delta(reasoning_content="Let me look at the diff. "),
+        _delta(reasoning_content="The loop is off by one. "),
+        _delta(reasoning_content="So the finding is the bound."),
+        _delta(content='{"findings": []}'),
+        {"choices": [{"delta": {}, "finish_reason": "stop"}], "model": "m"},
+    )
+    # every event costs 3 s against a 5 s first-token deadline: content arrives at ~15 s
+    result = parse_openai_chat_stream(iter(chunks), provider="local", model_data=SLOW, now_provider=_Clock(3.0))
+    assert result.content == '{"findings": []}'
+    assert "off by one" in (result.thinking or "")
+    assert "Let me look" not in result.content
+    assert result.metadata["thinking_stripped"] is True
+    assert result.metadata["streaming_recovery"]["config_applied"]["first_token_deadline_s"] == 5.0
+
+
+def test_control_without_reasoning_progress_the_deadline_fires():
+    chunks = _sse(
+        {"choices": [], "model": "m"},     # keep-alive-shaped frames: no content, no reasoning
+        {"choices": [], "model": "m"},
+        {"choices": [], "model": "m"},
+        _delta(content='{"findings": []}'),
+    )
+    with pytest.raises(StreamingRecoveryAbort) as info:
+        parse_openai_chat_stream(iter(chunks), provider="local", model_data=SLOW, now_provider=_Clock(3.0))
+    assert info.value.reason == "first_token_deadline"
+
+
+def test_reasoning_alias_key_and_no_empty_content_abort():
+    # 300 reasoning deltas exceed the 200-token empty-content window if they were fed as content
+    many = [_delta(reasoning="step ") for _ in range(300)]
+    chunks = _sse(*many, _delta(content="answer"))
+    result = parse_openai_chat_stream(iter(chunks), provider="local", now_provider=_Clock(0.001))
+    assert result.content == "answer"
+    assert result.thinking.startswith("step step")
+

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("raw, content, removed, stripped", [
+    ("<think>plan</think>\n{\"a\": 1}", '{"a": 1}', "plan", True),
+    ("  <THINK>one</THINK><think>two</think> answer", "answer", "one\ntwo", True),

+    chunks = _sse(_delta(content="<think>reasoning "), _delta(content="here</think>\n"),
+                  _delta(content='{"findings": [1]}'))
+    result = parse_openai_chat_stream(iter(chunks), provider="local", now_provider=_Clock(0.01))
+    assert result.content == '{"findings": [1]}'

+    assert result.metadata["thinking_stripped"] is True

+def test_hosted_shaped_stream_records_thinking_stripped_false():
+    chunks = _sse(_delta(content='{"findings": []}'))
+    result = parse_openai_chat_stream(iter(chunks), provider="openai", now_provider=_Clock(0.01))
+    assert result.content == '{"findings": []}'

+def _adapter(**model_kwargs: Any) -> OpenAIAdapter:
+    return OpenAIAdapter(ProviderConfig(
+        name="local", type="openai_compat", endpoint="http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1", auth="", keyless=True,

+def _req() -> CompletionRequest:

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("message, thinking", [

+def test_adapter_passes_the_models_streaming_recovery_block(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.delenv("LOA_CHEVAL_DISABLE_STREAMING", raising=False)
+    seen: Dict[str, Any] = {}
+    real = oa.parse_openai_chat_stream
+
+    def spy(byte_iter: Iterator[bytes], **kwargs: Any):
+        seen.update(kwargs)
+        return real(byte_iter, **kwargs)
+
+    class _Resp:
+        status_code = 200
+
+        def iter_bytes(self):
+            return iter(_sse(_delta(reasoning_content="hm"), _delta(content="ok")))
+
+    @contextmanager
+    def fake_stream(*a: Any, **k: Any):
+        yield _Resp()
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(oa, "parse_openai_chat_stream", spy)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(oa, "http_post_stream", fake_stream)
+    result = _adapter(streaming_recovery={"first_token_deadline_s": 120}).complete(_req())
+    assert seen["model_data"] == {"streaming_recovery": {"first_token_deadline_s": 120}}
+    assert result.content == "ok" and result.metadata["thinking_stripped"] is True

475	+"""hop-locality.py — classify model hops as local or hosted for `hounfour.locality: local_voices` (cycle-129 FR-8,
476	+SDD D-8.0 / D-8.1, DEC-0146).
477	+
478	+    python3 -I hop-locality.py --catalog <model-config.yaml> --config <.loa.config.yaml> -- <hop>...
479	+
480	+One tab-separated line per hop, in the order given:
481	+
482	+    <hop> TAB <provider|unknown> TAB <local|hosted> TAB <reason>
483	+
484	+A hop is `local` only when ALL of these hold in the merged view (the System Zone catalog overlaid with the project
485	+config's `hounfour.providers` / `hounfour.aliases`, the two layers cheval merges):
486	+  * it resolves (a `provider:id` pin, an alias chain, or a bare id that exactly one provider declares) to a model entry
487	+    that exists;
488	+  * that model entry, or its provider block, says `dispatch_group: local` (the canonical key, D-8.0);
489	+  * every hop on the entry's own `fallback_chain` is local by the same rule — cheval walks that chain inside one call,
490	+    so a local entry that falls back to a hosted one would leave the declared providers without the planner seeing it.
491	+Everything else is `hosted`: an unresolved hop, an unreadable config, a headless CLI hop (its dispatch group is the
492	+provider family's), the native session. Fail closed — a hop is never called local because it could not be read.
493	+
494	+This file reads declarations only: it never dispatches, never reads credentials and never imports the cheval package
495	+(run under `-I`, so neither the cwd nor PYTHONPATH reaches sys.path). The request-time rules for a local hop (IP-literal
496	+or localhost endpoint, no DNS, redirects refused, proxy env ignored, destination logged) are cheval's.

498	+from __future__ import annotations

501	+import sys
502	+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple
503	+
504	+MAX_DEPTH = 10
505	+

507	+def _merge(base: Any, overlay: Any) -> Any:
508	+    if isinstance(base, dict) and isinstance(overlay, dict):
509	+        out = dict(base)
510	+        for key, value in overlay.items():
511	+            out[key] = _merge(base.get(key), value) if key in base else value
512	+        return out
513	+    return overlay
514	+

516	+def load_merged(catalog_path: str, config_path: Optional[str]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
517	+    import yaml
518	+
519	+    with open(catalog_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
520	+        catalog = yaml.safe_load(fh) or {}
521	+    if not isinstance(catalog, dict):
522	+        raise ValueError("catalog is not a mapping")
523	+    merged: Dict[str, Any] = {k: (catalog.get(k) if isinstance(catalog.get(k), dict) else {})
524	+                              for k in ("providers", "aliases", "backward_compat_aliases")}
525	+    if config_path:
526	+        try:
527	+            with open(config_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
528	+                project = yaml.safe_load(fh) or {}
529	+        except FileNotFoundError:
530	+            project = {}
531	+        if not isinstance(project, dict):
532	+            raise ValueError("project config is not a mapping")
533	+        hounfour = project.get("hounfour")
534	+        if isinstance(hounfour, dict):
535	+            for key in ("providers", "aliases"):
536	+                if isinstance(hounfour.get(key), dict):
537	+                    merged[key] = _merge(merged.get(key) or {}, hounfour[key])
538	+    return merged

542	+    for table in ("aliases", "backward_compat_aliases"):
543	+        target = (merged.get(table) or {}).get(name)
544	+        if isinstance(target, dict):
545	+            target = target.get("target") or target.get("model")

551	+def resolve(hop: str, merged: Dict[str, Any]) -> Optional[Tuple[str, str]]:
552	+    name = (hop or "").strip()
553	+    if not name:
554	+        return None

556	+    for _ in range(MAX_DEPTH):
557	+        if ":" in current:
558	+            provider, _, model = current.partition(":")

571	+    matches = [p for p, block in providers.items()
572	+               if isinstance(block, dict) and isinstance(block.get("models"), dict) and current in block["models"]]

597	+    if not isinstance(chain, list):

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""hop-locality.py — classify model hops as local or hosted for `hounfour.locality: local_voices` (cycle-129 FR-8,
+SDD D-8.0 / D-8.1, DEC-0146).
+
+    python3 -I hop-locality.py --catalog <model-config.yaml> --config <.loa.config.yaml> -- <hop>...
+
+One tab-separated line per hop, in the order given:
+
+    <hop> TAB <provider|unknown> TAB <local|hosted> TAB <reason>
+
+A hop is `local` only when ALL of these hold in the merged view (the System Zone catalog overlaid with the project
+config's `hounfour.providers` / `hounfour.aliases`, the two layers cheval merges):
+  * it resolves (a `provider:id` pin, an alias chain, or a bare id that exactly one provider declares) to a model entry
+    that exists;
+  * that model entry, or its provider block, says `dispatch_group: local` (the canonical key, D-8.0);
+  * every hop on the entry's own `fallback_chain` is local by the same rule — cheval walks that chain inside one call,
+    so a local entry that falls back to a hosted one would leave the declared providers without the planner seeing it.
+Everything else is `hosted`: an unresolved hop, an unreadable config, a headless CLI hop (its dispatch group is the
+provider family's), the native session. Fail closed — a hop is never called local because it could not be read.
+
+This file reads declarations only: it never dispatches, never reads credentials and never imports the cheval package
+(run under `-I`, so neither the cwd nor PYTHONPATH reaches sys.path). The request-time rules for a local hop (IP-literal
+or localhost endpoint, no DNS, redirects refused, proxy env ignored, destination logged) are cheval's.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import sys
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple
+
+MAX_DEPTH = 10
+
+
+def _merge(base: Any, overlay: Any) -> Any:
+    if isinstance(base, dict) and isinstance(overlay, dict):
+        out = dict(base)
+        for key, value in overlay.items():
+            out[key] = _merge(base.get(key), value) if key in base else value
+        return out
+    return overlay
+
+
+def load_merged(catalog_path: str, config_path: Optional[str]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    import yaml
+
+    with open(catalog_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+        catalog = yaml.safe_load(fh) or {}
+    if not isinstance(catalog, dict):
+        raise ValueError("catalog is not a mapping")
+    merged: Dict[str, Any] = {k: (catalog.get(k) if isinstance(catalog.get(k), dict) else {})
+                              for k in ("providers", "aliases", "backward_compat_aliases")}
+    if config_path:
+        try:
+            with open(config_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+                project = yaml.safe_load(fh) or {}
+        except FileNotFoundError:
+            project = {}
+        if not isinstance(project, dict):
+            raise ValueError("project config is not a mapping")
+        hounfour = project.get("hounfour")
+        if isinstance(hounfour, dict):
+            for key in ("providers", "aliases"):
+                if isinstance(hounfour.get(key), dict):
+                    merged[key] = _merge(merged.get(key) or {}, hounfour[key])
+    return merged
+
+
+def _alias_target(name: str, merged: Dict[str, Any]) -> Optional[str]:
+    for table in ("aliases", "backward_compat_aliases"):
+        target = (merged.get(table) or {}).get(name)
+        if isinstance(target, dict):
+            target = target.get("target") or target.get("model")
+        if isinstance(target, str) and target.strip():
+            return target.strip()
+    return None
+
+
+def resolve(hop: str, merged: Dict[str, Any]) -> Optional[Tuple[str, str]]:
+    name = (hop or "").strip()
+    if not name:
+        return None
+    current, seen = name, set()
+    for _ in range(MAX_DEPTH):
+        if ":" in current:
+            provider, _, model = current.partition(":")
+            return (provider, model) if provider and model else None
+        target = _alias_target(current, merged)
+        if not target:
+            break
+        if target in seen:
+            return None
+        seen.add(current)
+        current = target
+    if ":" in current:
+        provider, _, model = current.partition(":")
+        return (provider, model) if provider and model else None
+    providers = merged.get("providers") or {}
+    matches = [p for p, block in providers.items()
+               if isinstance(block, dict) and isinstance(block.get("models"), dict) and current in block["models"]]
+    return (matches[0], current) if len(matches) == 1 else None
+
+
+def classify(hop: str, merged: Dict[str, Any], _depth: int = 0, _seen: Optional[set] = None) -> Tuple[str, str, str]:
+    """(provider, locality, reason) for one hop."""
+    seen = set(_seen or ())
+    target = resolve(hop, merged)
+    if target is None:
+        return "unknown", "hosted", "unresolved"
+    provider, model = target
+    block = (merged.get("providers") or {}).get(provider)
+    if not isinstance(block, dict):
+        return provider, "hosted", "provider_not_declared"
+    entry = (block.get("models") or {}).get(model) if isinstance(block.get("models"), dict) else None
+    if not isinstance(entry, dict):
+        return provider, "hosted", "model_not_declared"
+    group = entry.get("dispatch_group") or block.get("dispatch_group") or ""
+    if group != "local":
+        return provider, "hosted", f"dispatch_group={group or 'unset'}"
+    key = f"{provider}:{model}"
+    if key in seen:
+        return provider, "local", "dispatch_group=local"
+    seen.add(key)
+    chain = entry.get("fallback_chain") or []
+    if not isinstance(chain, list):
+        return provider, "hosted", "fallback_chain_unreadable"
+    if _depth >= MAX_DEPTH:
+        return provider, "hosted", "fallback_chain_too_deep"
+    for nxt in chain:
+        if not isinstance(nxt, str):
+            return provider, "hosted", "fallback_chain_unreadable"
+        p2, loc, _ = classify(nxt, merged, _depth + 1, seen)
+        if loc != "local":
+            return provider, "hosted", f"fallback_chain_reaches_hosted:{nxt}({p2})"
+    return provider, "local", "dispatch_group=local"
+
+
+def _clean(text: str) -> str:
+    return "".join(c if c.isprintable() and c not in "\t" else "_" for c in text)[:128]
+
+
+def main(argv: Optional[List[str]] = None) -> int:
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.split("\n")[0])
+    ap.add_argument("--catalog", required=True)
+    ap.add_argument("--config", default="")
+    ap.add_argument("hops", nargs="*")
+    args = ap.parse_args(argv)
+    try:
+        merged = load_merged(args.catalog, args.config or None)
+        err = ""
+    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 — fail closed: every hop hosted, the reason said once
+        merged, err = None, f"{type(exc).__name__}"
+        print(f"hop-locality: the merged config could not be read ({err}) — every hop is hosted", file=sys.stderr)
+    for hop in args.hops:
+        if merged is None:
+            print(f"{_clean(hop)}\tunknown\thosted\tconfig_unreadable")
+            continue
+        provider, loc, reason = classify(hop, merged)
+        print(f"{_clean(hop)}\t{_clean(provider)}\t{loc}\t{_clean(reason)}")
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+// cycle-129 Sprint 3 Task 3.4 (SDD D-7.7, DEC-0150): the completion banner counts the voices whose result completed, and a
+// DEGRADED consensus exits bridgebuilder.exit_on_degraded (default 3; 0 restores the old exit) after the JSON is written.
+import { describe, it } from "node:test";
+import assert from "node:assert/strict";
+import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
+import { dirname, join } from "node:path";
+import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
+import { decideExitCode, degradedWarnLine, summarizeVoices, totalVoices } from "../core/run-outcome.js";
+import type { MultiModelReviewResult } from "../core/multi-model-pipeline.js";
+
+type MR = MultiModelReviewResult["modelResults"][number];
+
+function ok(provider: string, model: string, status?: string): MR {
+  return {
+    provider, model, posted: false,
+    response: {
+      content: "", inputTokens: 1, outputTokens: 1, model,
+      ...(status ? { verdictQuality: { status, voices_planned: 1, voices_succeeded: 1, chain_health: "ok" } } : {}),
+    } as MR["response"],
+  };
+}
+function failed(provider: string, model: string): MR {
+  return {
+    provider, model, posted: false,
+    error: { code: "PROVIDER_ERROR", message: "boom", category: "transient", retryable: true, source: "llm" } as MR["error"],
+  };
+}
+
+describe("voice outcome and exit code (D-7.7)", () => {
+  it("all planned voices completed and approved: not degraded, exit 0", () => {
+    const o = summarizeVoices({
+      modelResults: [ok("anthropic", "opus", "APPROVED"), ok("openai", "gpt-5.5", "APPROVED")],
+      voicesPlanned: ["anthropic/opus", "openai/gpt-5.5"],
+    });
+    assert.deepEqual(o, { planned: 2, completed: 2, band: "APPROVED", incomplete: [], degraded: false });
+    assert.equal(decideExitCode(o.degraded, 3), 0);
+  });
+
+  it("a failed voice: completed < planned, the voice named, DEGRADED exits 3 (and 0 under the rollback key)", () => {
+    const o = summarizeVoices({
+      modelResults: [ok("anthropic", "opus", "APPROVED"), failed("openai", "gpt-5.5")],
+      voicesPlanned: ["anthropic/opus", "openai/gpt-5.5"],
+    });
+    assert.equal(o.completed, 1);
+    assert.equal(o.planned, 2);
+    assert.deepEqual(o.incomplete, ["openai/gpt-5.5"]);
+    assert.equal(o.degraded, true);
+    assert.equal(decideExitCode(o.degraded, 3), 3);
+    assert.equal(decideExitCode(o.degraded, 0), 0);
+  });
+
+  it("a planned voice that never ran (missing key, graceful mode) counts as incomplete", () => {
+    const o = summarizeVoices({
+      modelResults: [ok("anthropic", "opus")],
+      voicesPlanned: ["anthropic/opus", "google/gemini-3-pro"],
+    });
+    assert.equal(o.completed, 1);
+    assert.equal(o.planned, 2);
+    assert.deepEqual(o.incomplete, ["google/gemini-3-pro"]);
+    assert.equal(o.degraded, true);
+  });
+
+  it("every voice completed but the verdict-quality band is DEGRADED: still degraded", () => {
+    const o = summarizeVoices({
+      modelResults: [ok("anthropic", "opus", "APPROVED"), ok("openai", "gpt-5.5", "DEGRADED")],
+      voicesPlanned: ["anthropic/opus", "openai/gpt-5.5"],
+    });
+    assert.equal(o.completed, 2);
+    assert.equal(o.band, "DEGRADED");
+    assert.equal(o.degraded, true);
+    assert.equal(decideExitCode(o.degraded, 3), 3);
+  });
+
+  it("legacy envelopes (no verdictQuality) with every voice complete are not degraded", () => {
+    const o = summarizeVoices({ modelResults: [ok("anthropic", "opus"), ok("openai", "gpt-5.5")] });
+    assert.equal(o.band, null);
+    assert.equal(o.degraded, false);
+    assert.equal(o.planned, 2);
+  });
+
+  it("totals sum across items; the WARN line names the voices and the exit", () => {
+    const a = summarizeVoices({ modelResults: [ok("anthropic", "opus", "APPROVED")], voicesPlanned: ["anthropic/opus"] });
+    const b = summarizeVoices({ modelResults: [ok("anthropic", "opus", "APPROVED"), failed("openai", "gpt-5.5")], voicesPlanned: ["anthropic/opus", "openai/gpt-5.5"] });
+    const t = totalVoices([a, b]);
+    assert.deepEqual(t, { completed: 2, planned: 3, degraded: true, incomplete: ["openai/gpt-5.5"] });
+    const line = degradedWarnLine(t, [a.band, b.band], 3);
+    // (b's band is DEGRADED: one of its voices carried no envelope)
+    assert.equal(line, "[bridgebuilder] WARN: DEGRADED — 2/3 voices completed; incomplete voices: openai/gpt-5.5; verdict quality: DEGRADED (exit 3; bridgebuilder.exit_on_degraded)");
+    assert.equal(totalVoices([]).degraded, false);
+  });
+});

+    assert.match(src, /decideExitCode\(totals\.degraded, trusted\.exitOnDegraded\)/);
+  });
+});

+  local d="$1" type="$2" sprint_id="$3" timeout="$4" diff_files="$5" alias="$6" raw="" rc=0 res="" st=""

+            slow)  bash -c 'exec -a "$0" sleep 300' "loa-s3adv-slow-$$"; return 0 ;;
+            *) echo "stub: no arm for '$b'" >&2; return 99 ;;
+        esac
+    }
+    _s3_vq() {  # <voice> <ok|fail> [reason] [exit]
+        if [[ "$2" == ok ]]; then
+            jq -nc --arg v "$1" '{status:"APPROVED",consensus_outcome:"consensus",truncation_waiver_applied:false,voices_planned:1,voices_succeeded:1,voices_succeeded_ids:[$v],voices_dropped:[],chain_health:"ok",confidence_floor:"low",rationale:"stub",single_voice_call:true}'
+        else
+            jq -nc --arg v "$1" --arg r "$3" --argjson e "$4" '{status:"FAILED",consensus_outcome:"consensus",truncation_waiver_applied:false,voices_planned:1,voices_succeeded:0,voices_succeeded_ids:[],voices_dropped:[{voice:$v,reason:$r,exit_code:$e,blocker_risk:"unknown"}],chain_health:"exhausted",confidence_floor:"low",rationale:"stub",single_voice_call:true}'
+        fi
+    }
+    export PYTHONPATH="$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/adapters"
+}
+
+s3_teardown() {
+    pkill -KILL -f "loa-s3adv-slow-$$"'( |$)' 2>/dev/null || true
+    [[ -n "${SPRINT:-}" && "$SPRINT" == "${S3_PREFIX:-x}"-* && -n "${PROJECT_ROOT:-}" ]] || return 0
+    local d="$PROJECT_ROOT/grimoires/loa/a2a/$SPRINT"
+    if [[ -d "$d" && ! -L "$d" ]]; then find "$d" -mindepth 1 -delete; rmdir "$d"; fi
+    return 0
+}
+
+s3_config() {  # <yaml body> → the test's .loa.config.yaml (owner-only)
+    printf '%s\n' "$1" > "$CONFIG_FILE"
+}
+
+s3_run() {  # <review|audit> → main's stdout (main runs in a subshell: it exits); stderr to $T/stderr.log; the status in $T/rc
+    local rc=0
+    ( main --type "${1:-review}" --sprint-id "$SPRINT" --diff-file "$T/diff.patch" --json ) 2> "$T/stderr.log" || rc=$?
+    printf '%s' "$rc" > "$T/rc"
+}
+
+s3_norm() {  # <envelope file> → the envelope without advisory_voices, keys sorted, and only the clock-dependent fields removed
+    # (the normalised compare: a timestamp and the repairs' measured wall seconds differ between any two runs, advisory or not)
+    jq -S 'del(.advisory_voices) | walk(if type == "object" then del(.timestamp, .ts_utc, .repair_wall_seconds) else . end)' "$1"
+}

index 00000000..2929ee1e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/unit/bb-exit-degraded-callers.bats
@@ -0,0 +1,130 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env bats
+# cycle-129 Sprint 3 Task 3.4 (SDD D-7.7, DEC-0150): Bridgebuilder exits 3 when a multi-model review COMPLETED with a
+# DEGRADED consensus. Every shell caller that tests the exit code treats 3 as "completed, degraded": one WARN line naming
+# the incomplete voices, never a failure. A stub Bridgebuilder entry.sh stands in for the real one.
+
+setup() {
+    BATS_TEST_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$BATS_TEST_FILENAME")" && pwd)"
+    PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "$BATS_TEST_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
+    WORK="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/bb-exit-degraded.XXXXXX")"
+    STUB="$WORK/stub-entry.sh"
+}
+
+teardown() {
+    [[ -n "${WORK:-}" && -d "$WORK" ]] && rm -rf "$WORK"
+}
+
+# make_stub <exit_code>: a stub entry.sh that prints a run JSON naming one incomplete voice, then exits <exit_code>
+make_stub() {
+    cat > "$STUB" <<'STUB_EOF'
+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+echo '{"mode":"multi-model","degraded":true,"verdicts":[{"pr":7,"voices":{"planned":2,"completed":1,"incomplete":["openai/gpt-5.5"]}}]}'
+STUB_EOF
+    echo "exit $1" >> "$STUB"
+    chmod +x "$STUB"
+}
+
+# --- session-cap-bb dispatcher.sh ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+run_dispatcher() {
+    local cid="cyc-$1"
+    local handoff="$WORK/tmp/loa-session-cap-bb.$cid"
+    mkdir -p "$handoff"
+    printf '{"action":"dispatch"}' > "$handoff/decider.json"
+    DISPATCHER_JSON="$handoff/dispatcher.json"
+    run env TMPDIR="$WORK/tmp" LOA_SESSION_CAP_BB_ENTRY="$STUB" LOA_SESSION_CAP_BB_REPO="fixture/repo" \
+        bash "$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/skills/scheduled-cycle-template/contracts/session-cap-bb/dispatcher.sh" "$cid" sched-1 0 '[]'
+}
+
+@test "dispatcher: Bridgebuilder exit 3 is completed-degraded — WARN names the voice, handoff degraded, exit 0" {
+    make_stub 3
+    run_dispatcher a
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"WARN: bridgebuilder completed DEGRADED (exit 3): incomplete voices: openai/gpt-5.5"* ]]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.bb_exit_code' "$DISPATCHER_JSON")" = "3" ]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.degraded' "$DISPATCHER_JSON")" = "true" ]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.incomplete_voices' "$DISPATCHER_JSON")" = "openai/gpt-5.5" ]
+}
+
+@test "dispatcher: Bridgebuilder's run JSON still reaches stdout" {
+    make_stub 3
+    run_dispatcher b
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *'"mode":"multi-model"'* ]]
+}
+
+@test "dispatcher: exit 0 stays 0 with degraded false and no WARN" {
+    make_stub 0
+    run_dispatcher c
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    [[ "$output" != *"DEGRADED"* ]]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.degraded' "$DISPATCHER_JSON")" = "false" ]
+    [ "$(jq -r 'has("incomplete_voices")' "$DISPATCHER_JSON")" = "false" ]
+}
+
+@test "dispatcher: any other non-zero exit is still a failure" {
+    make_stub 1
+    run_dispatcher d
+    [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.bb_exit_code' "$DISPATCHER_JSON")" = "1" ]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.degraded' "$DISPATCHER_JSON")" = "false" ]
+}
+
+# --- spiral-harness.sh _gate_bridgebuilder ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+# run_gate <exit_code>: source the harness, point it at a fake skills tree holding the stub, run the gate
+run_gate() {
+    make_stub "$1"
+    mkdir -p "$WORK/fake/scripts" "$WORK/fake/skills/bridgebuilder-review/resources" "$WORK/evidence"
+    cp "$STUB" "$WORK/fake/skills/bridgebuilder-review/resources/entry.sh"
+    run bash -c '
+        cd "$1" || exit 99
+        source "$2/.claude/scripts/spiral-harness.sh"
+        set +e
+        SCRIPT_DIR="$1/fake/scripts"
+        EVIDENCE_DIR="$1/evidence"
+        _record_action() { echo "RECORDED:$1:${10}"; }
+        _gate_bridgebuilder "https://github.com/fixture/repo/pull/7"
+        echo "GATE_RC=$?"
+    ' _ "$WORK" "$PROJECT_ROOT"
+}
+
+@test "spiral-harness gate: Bridgebuilder exit 3 logs one WARN naming the voice and the gate passes" {
+    run_gate 3
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"WARN: Bridgebuilder review iter 1 completed DEGRADED (exit 3): incomplete voices: openai/gpt-5.5"* ]]
+    [[ "$output" == *"RECORDED:GATE_BRIDGEBUILDER:posted"* ]]
+    [[ "$output" == *"GATE_RC=0"* ]]
+    [ "$(grep -c 'DEGRADED' <<<"$output")" -eq 1 ]
+}
+
+@test "spiral-harness gate: exit 0 logs no WARN" {
+    run_gate 0
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    [[ "$output" != *"WARN: Bridgebuilder"* ]]
+    [[ "$output" == *"GATE_RC=0"* ]]
+}
+
+@test "spiral-harness gate: another non-zero exit is logged as not completed (non-blocking, as before)" {
+    run_gate 1
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"WARN: Bridgebuilder review iter 1 exited 1 (the review did not complete)"* ]]
+    [[ "$output" == *"GATE_RC=0"* ]]
+}
+
+@test "spiral-harness: every entry.sh invocation goes through _bb_surface_exit (no bare || true)" {
+    local script="$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/spiral-harness.sh"
+    local invocations surfaced
+    invocations=$(grep -c '"\$entry_script" --pr' "$script")
+    surfaced=$(grep -c '_bb_surface_exit "\$bb_rc"' "$script")
+    [ "$invocations" -ge 2 ]
+    [ "$invocations" -eq "$surfaced" ]
+}
+
+@test "entry.sh: the missing-dependency preflight exits 4, never the DEGRADED code 3" {
+    local entry="$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/skills/bridgebuilder-review/resources/entry.sh"
+    run grep -n '^  exit 3$' "$entry"
+    [ "$status" -ne 0 ]
+    run grep -c '^  exit 4$' "$entry"
+    [ "$output" = "1" ]
+}
